title: Persian GPT — 110M Transformer From Scratch
description: A 110.4M-parameter decoder-only transformer trained end to end for Persian. The project covers a cleaned Wikipedia corpus, custom 32K BPE tokenizer, training pipeline, n-gram baselines, and held-out evaluation.
type: Flagship model · Persian NLP · From-scratch training
note: A research portfolio model; the held-out perplexity is a language-model metric, not an instruction-following benchmark.

research.context: This project demonstrates an end-to-end low-resource language-model workflow for Persian, from corpus preparation through tokenizer design, training, and held-out evaluation.
research.limitations: The reported perplexity is specific to the held-out corpus and tokenizer. It is not a measure of factuality, instruction following, or downstream task performance.

title: 3D Cardiac MRI Segmentation
description: A complete 3D cardiac MRI segmentation pipeline using PyTorch, MONAI, and a 3D U-Net. It covers NIfTI loading, preprocessing, mixed-precision training, sliding-window inference, and voxel-level evaluation on Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task02 Heart.
note: Research project on a public benchmark dataset; not clinically validated or deployed for clinical decision-making.

research.context: The project investigates voxel-level cardiac structure segmentation from volumetric MRI, a setting where models must use three-dimensional spatial context.
research.limitations: The reported validation Dice is from this project’s benchmark split. The system has not been clinically validated and is not a clinical decision-support tool.

title: AI Research Assistant Platform
description: A multi-agent research assistant built with LangGraph, ChromaDB RAG, FastAPI, and LangSmith. Planning, retrieval, parallel research, tool execution, citation-grounded synthesis, bounded reflection, persistent state, and streaming are covered in the public implementation.
note: Offline tests use a deterministic fake-LLM mode; the test count measures exercised software behavior, not answer quality.

research.context: This system explores how retrieval, web research, tools, synthesis, and bounded reflection can be orchestrated and tested as a stateful research workflow.
methods: LangGraph stateful workflow with parallel branches
ChromaDB retrieval and local ONNX embeddings
SQLite persistence and FastAPI REST/SSE endpoints
Deterministic offline suite plus LangSmith evaluation tooling
research.limitations: The offline suite validates application contracts with deterministic model behavior. It does not establish comparative research-answer quality or clinical safety.

title: CohortSeal
description: Patient-level split audits catch patient and exact-duplicate leakage before model evaluation. CohortSeal creates reproducible group splits and stores findings in SQLite, with CLI and FastAPI workflows plus MONAI, DICOM, and Hugging Face adapters.

title: Holdout Ledger: Dataset Leakage Audit Workbench
description: A local workbench for inspecting text and entity overlap across train, validation, and test splits. Includes an evidence dashboard, offline reports, SQLite audit snapshots, and reviewed repair plans that preserve every test record. CI checks track newly exposed holdout IDs; lexical detection limits are documented.

title: Agent Guardrails — Five Composable Skills for AI Coding Agents
description: A lifecycle of five Agent Skills that gate AI coding agents before expensive mistakes happen. recon researches the task and proposes self-rules; preflight runs the cheapest version first and estimates cost as a range; hold stops on unhandled failures and offers three recovery options; scope catches drift outside agreed boundaries; budget enforces the preflight estimate. Portable across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Copilot via the open Agent Skills standard.

title: Jibay2 Medical — Clinical Note Summarization
description: A QLoRA fine-tune of JibayAi/Jibay_2 for converting fragmented clinical shorthand into structured patient summaries.

title: Messy2JSON — Lightweight Structured Extraction
description: Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned with QLoRA to convert messy English text into structured JSON.

title: Persian Wikipedia Cleaned For Persian NLP
description: A cleaned Persian Wikipedia dataset with 855,724 documents used for Persian language-model training.

title: NLLB English-to-Persian Psychology Translation
description: A domain adaptation of NLLB-200-distilled-600M for English-to-Persian psychology translation.

title: Messy2Json Qwen 0.5B Lora
description: LoRA adapter for the Messy2JSON Qwen model.
